source.description: The PoC bytes are opened as a FILE stream with fmemopen for sudoers policy parsing; this helper is the attacker-controlled input load point rather than the libFuzzer entry frame.

sink.description: ASan reports the second free at sudoers_gc_run when the stale GC_PTR entry for editor is collected.

root_cause.description: The error path frees editor directly after find_path fails, but editor is still registered in sudoers GC because copy_arg added it at allocation time.

taint_source.description: The fuzz input is converted into a FILE stream that the policy harness parses into settings, argv, and environment state.

tainted_value_origin.description: Policy input lines are read from the fmemopen-backed stream and later populate settings/argv state that drives sudoers_policy.check_policy.

coarse_trace.summary: Loads PoC bytes into a FILE stream for policy parsing.
Parses the input lines into plugin settings, argv, user info, and environment arrays, then runs sudoers_policy.check_policy.
Policy check dispatches into sudoers_policy_main for command resolution.
MODE_EDIT invokes find_editor to locate the configured editor.
Selects an editor candidate and calls resolve_editor.
Allocates and GC-registers the editor string, then frees it directly on not-found error without removing the GC entry.
Final GC cleanup frees the stale editor pointer again.

root_cause_analysis.summary: The PoC is loaded as policy input, parsed into policy state, and drives a sudoers edit-mode path that calls find_editor. resolve_editor copies an editor candidate with copy_arg; copy_arg both allocates the editor string and registers it in sudoers GC. When find_path cannot locate that editor, resolve_editor frees editor directly but does not remove the GC entry. At the end of the fuzz iteration, sudoers_gc_run walks the GC list and frees the stale editor pointer again, producing the ASan double-free.
root_cause_analysis.why_patch_works: The patch calls sudoers_gc_remove(GC_PTR, editor) before every error-path free(editor) in resolve_editor. This keeps the GC ownership list synchronized with the direct free, so sudoers_gc_run no longer sees the already-freed editor pointer and the second free is prevented. The same PoC exits without the ASan double-free in the fixed ARVO image.
